Esther Concilor

Preserved Primary Document • concl-h1.htm

Hester/Esther Concilor was born in Kent County DE. She was the daughter of Jeremiah Concilor (d.1811) and his wife, Elizabeth. Her name appears sometimes as Esther, sometimes as Hester. On August 29, 1814 "Esther" Concilor married Jesse Dean. Her uncle, Benjamin Concilor, signed the marriage bond. We do not know much about this Jesse Dean. Clearly he was a member of the mixed blood Dean family of Kent Co. and he was probably related to Jesse Sr. (son of James Dean) and Jesse Jr. (son of Jesse Sr.) of Little Creek Hundred but we do not yet know the relationship. Esther and Jesse Dean had the following children : Jeremiah Dean (died after 1845) By 1818, however, Esther was married to Elisha Durham (1794-1864), which indicates her first husband, Jesse, had died. Thanks to an Orphans Court petition filed by son, Joel Durham, in 1864, we know that Hester and Elisha Durham had the following children: Joel Durham (b.c. 1818) who married Margaret Munce Isaac Durham Elijah Durham (died. bef. 1864) children: (all minors in 1864) Isaiah Durham Elijah Durham Mary Durham Catherine Durham Elisha Durham John Durham Elizabeth Durham who married Bayman Williams David Durham Mary Durham who married George Clark Hester Durham who married David Driggers Ann Durham infant Durham
